title: Milestones 1-3 + first conformance: PROC1_$TST_LOCK byte-identical
description: Rust workspace + Python conformance harness; lexer/preprocessor/parser with unit tests; minimal semantics+codegen so PROC1_$TST_LOCK (0xE148CA, 0x1C) compiles to bytes identical to the SR10.2 SAU2 image. CLAUDE.md section 8, milestones 1-3 (+ first routine of milestone 4).

title: Rust workspace skeleton + compiler driver + test runner
description: Cargo workspace (crates per phase behind clear interfaces: syntax, sema, ir, m68k backend, driver binary 'dpc'). Empty driver accepting a .pas and writing .s. cargo test wired. Top-level Makefile or script running cargo test + python harness tests.

title: Python conformance harness: assemble/link at image address, compare bytes with SR10.2 image
description: tools/conform.py: assemble .s with m68k-elf-as (-m68010), link with m68k-elf-ld at the routine's image VA with an external-symbol table taken from the SAU2 map (tools/symbols, e.g. PROC1_$CURRENT_PCB 0xE1EAC8), extract bytes, compare with image bytes (offset = VA-0xDFFC00); on mismatch show side-by-side imgdis. Self-test: a hand-written .s for PROC1_$TST_LOCK must pass, a perturbed one must fail.

title: Lexer + % preprocessor with unit tests
description: Ref 2.1 (identifiers with _ and $, case-insensitivity 2.1.6, based integers 16#1c6 2.1.2, three comment forms 2.1.4, string escapes 2.1.5.1) and 4.7 compiler directives (%include with search paths, %if/%ifdef/%else/%elseif/%elseifdef/%endif, %config, %enable, %error, %exit; others tokenised/ignored with TODO issues). Tokens carry source positions.

title: Parser + AST for kernel subset with unit tests
description: Recursive descent. module heading with sections (7.1, 7.1.1), declaration parts in any order (const/type/var/label/define/extern/static, routine_option), types (integer/integer16/integer32, boolean, char, subranges, enums, sets, records incl. variant/packed, arrays, pointers, univ_ptr, procedure pointer types), procedure/function headings with param modes (5.3) and options (5.5), attribute lists [section(..)] (5.7.1), statements and expressions of ch. 4 incl. Domain extensions. One test per construct. No AST interfaces in m68k terms (CLAUDE.md 4.5).

title: Semantics: symbols, types, layout, Table 5-1 parameter conventions (subset for TST_LOCK)
description: Symbol tables with nested scopes, type checking for the subset, data layout (sizes per codegen-patterns 5, record offsets, set sizes/bit order 3.9.3), param-passing decisions per Table 5-1 (default by-address; val_param/internal by value for <=4-byte value/in scalars; univ cancels). Unit tests encode Table 5-1 rows and layout examples.

title: IR + m68k codegen + gas emitter: PROC1_$TST_LOCK byte-identical
description: Lower to IR, select instructions, emit gas for m68k-elf-as -m68010 with explicit sizes. Reproduce 0xE148CA exactly: link.w #-4; movea.l abs.l,A0; move.w (8,A6),D0; move.l (0x40,A0),D1; btst D0,D1; sne D1; move.b D1,D0; unlk; rts. Write tests/conformance/proc1_tst_lock.pas (reconstructed decls from ../source/domain_os/proc1 headers) + golden .s; harness passes.

title: Sema: predeclare remaining built-ins (addr, sizeof, firstof/lastof, succ/pred, discard, set_sr, min/max, in_range)
description: Not predeclared after 0sp.5; kernel code needs addr/sizeof/set_sr at least. Cite ch. 4 entries and Appendix E.

title: Sema: integer16 := 16#FFFF rejected - verify Apollo behaviour
description: Ref 3.4 NOTE allows 16#FFFFFFFF as -1 for integer32; unclear for 16-bit. Find evidence before changing.

title: Sema: array initialisers expand to one InitStore per element
description: Huge [n of v] initialisers cost memory/time; consider run-length InitStore.

title: Parser nesting cap 128 may be low for real code; consider bigger-stack parse thread + driver diagnostic cap
description: Review of 0sp.4 added MAX_DEPTH=128 nesting guard (debug build overflowed ~186 parens on 2MB stack). Each source nesting level may consume several guard levels. Option: run the front end on a thread with a large stack and raise the cap. Also cap number of diagnostics printed by the driver (100k-error garbage case).

title: After v1: evaluate replacing hand-written parser/plumbing with a library (e.g. chumsky)
description: Owner (2026-10-11): keep hand-written recursive descent for v1; once v1 is done, investigate refactoring to remove code from the repo, e.g. a parser-combinator library (chumsky) over the existing token stream. Check toolchain compatibility (cargo 1.83) and that diagnostics/recovery stay as good. CLAUDE.md 4.1 would need updating.

title: Parse write/writeln field widths (x:w:d)
description: Out of scope (I/O) but many reference example programs use them; parser rejects 'writeln(x:5)'.

title: conform.py literal-address check may false-positive on Pascal numeric constants equal to map addresses
description: Review of domain-pascal-0sp.2 added a check rejecting unrelocated 32-bit fields equal to a map symbol address >= 0x10000. Kernel Pascal may legitimately use numeric constants (hardware addresses, e.g. 16#FF.... constants) that coincide with map symbols. Revisit when a real routine trips it.

title: Sema: reject duplicate variant labels in records
Loop-head 0x2048 alignment when a conformance unit starts at VA not 4-aligned
description: Loop heads are 4-aligned with 0x2048 relative to absolute address (module code base is 4-aligned; codegen-patterns 7). A conformance unit that is a subset of a module (e.g. PROC1_$TST_LOCK at 0xE148CA, 2 mod 4) linked as its own section would pad wrongly if the emitter uses .balign relative to section start. Decide: compiler option giving the origin mod 4, or harness prepends filler so the section starts at VA&~3, or compile whole modules. Raised by harness work on domain-pascal-0sp.2.

title: Owner rulings needed: open reference questions (1-10, 12-14)
description: See docs/reference-clarifications.md 'Open questions' items 1-8. Conservative choices implemented, marked TODO(ref-question) in crates/dpc-syntax/src/.
